count_note: Slash chunks preserve literal labels; they are not semantic test cases. Cover every named option and interaction, including parenthetical choices. Do not force a passing count of 150.

records.label: Menu (hamburger)
records.required: Small labelled overflow/menu trigger in compact app bar; application destinations separated from document tools.
records.acceptance: Menu remains visible after valid/failed Markdown opens; 48dp target; focus and expanded state correct.

records.label: Dismiss menu by Escape / Dismiss menu by outside tap
records.required: Use one complete menu interaction primitive with predictable dismissal and menu-key navigation.
records.acceptance: Tap outside/Escape closes once; focus returns; keyboard can traverse all menu items.

records.label: Open… (menu) / Open file… (empty state) / Open (requested + menu)
records.required: Wire one Open action to existing ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT in the requested FAB menu. Empty state points to Add document.
records.acceptance: Cold launcher and warm app can select a file; cancellation returns unchanged; URI permission retained.

records.label: + floating action button
records.required: Fixed bottom-right Material FAB menu, inset-aware, opening choices at the same location.
records.acceptance: Always reachable in idle document/launcher states; does not cover content controls or system gesture area.

records.label: New Markdown
records.required: FAB menu item creates an editable untitled .md draft with preview and save lifecycle.
records.acceptance: Create, type, preview, save via Android picker, close and reopen without losing content.

records.label: New text
records.required: FAB menu item creates an editable untitled .txt draft using existing text engine.
records.acceptance: Create, type, save/cancel/retry, close and reopen; dirty state/recovery remain accurate.

records.label: Close expanded + menu
records.required: Colocated close control and Back/outside-tap dismissal without triggering an item.
records.acceptance: All three labelled choices reachable; close/Back leaves document unchanged.

records.label: About
records.required: About sheet/page with installed version/build identity and project/support links.
records.acceptance: Reachable with no document and after renderer failure; displayed version matches installed build.

records.label: Preferences (menu)
records.required: Retain application-level destination; adapt sheet/page by window size.
records.acceptance: Opens from empty/loaded app; Back/Close returns to same document and focus.

records.label: Diagnostics (menu)
records.required: Keep under application menu and root recovery surface.
records.acceptance: Reachable after contained and root-level failures; opening does not destroy document state.

records.label: Skip to content
records.required: Retain and make target the useful document/content focus location.
records.acceptance: Keyboard activation moves focus past repeated chrome; visible focus is not obscured.

records.label: Android Back
records.required: One Back owner: resolve IME/top transient surface first; prompt for dirty work only when destination Back would abandon it.
records.acceptance: Back never silently discards draft or exits before closing topmost transient surface.

records.label: GitHub project link
records.required: Clearly labelled external link to verified project repository.
records.acceptance: Opens correct repository through native external-link gateway; return restores About.

records.label: ShruggieTech link
records.required: Clearly labelled company link in About.
records.acceptance: Opens verified ShruggieTech homepage; return preserves current document.

records.label: Documentation link / Help / documentation (application menu)
records.required: Clearly labelled documentation link in About.
records.acceptance: Opens verified documentation destination; unavailable destination receives visible feedback.

records.label: Licenses
records.required: Link About to bundled application and third-party notices with readable navigation.
records.acceptance: Notices open offline, scroll accessibly and return to About without losing the document.

records.label: Report an issue
records.required: Open the verified GitHub issue destination from Help/About; offer optional redacted diagnostics without automatic upload.
records.acceptance: Correct destination opens; no document or diagnostic payload leaves the app without the chosen share action.

records.label: Activate inline document tab / Activate document in overflow list
records.required: Compact document switcher; expanded tabs retained; shared activation handler.
records.acceptance: Switching preserves source, scroll, draft and viewport; current document is labelled.

records.label: Close inline document / Close overflow document / Ctrl+W close current document
records.required: Retain explicit close within document switcher with dirty-state resolution.
records.acceptance: Closing clean document works; dirty close offers save/discard/cancel and preserves edits on failure.

records.label: More open documents (overflow trigger)
records.required: Compact document-count/switcher control instead of a clipped tab strip.
records.acceptance: Every open document reachable without horizontal toolbar hunting; popup fits viewport.

records.label: Previous/next document (Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab) / First/last tab (Home/End) / Previous/next tab (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight)
records.required: Retain shortcuts; expose equivalent touch switcher.
records.acceptance: Each command activates exactly one intended document and updates accessible selection.

records.label: Reorder tab (Alt+Shift+ArrowLeft / ArrowRight)
records.required: Retain accessible reorder where useful; make compact document ordering clear.
records.acceptance: Ordering changes without changing content or losing focus; boundaries handled.

records.label: Copy (menu / Ctrl+C)
records.required: Single clipboard action with selection/document semantics and result feedback.
records.acceptance: Copies intended data; denied/unavailable clipboard shows failure rather than success.

records.label: Search (menu / Ctrl+F)
records.required: One Find entry point activating current renderer's accessible search tool.
records.acceptance: Text, Markdown, Mermaid and large-text search each open a usable contextual tool.

records.label: Find next (menu / F3) / Next (Markdown search) / next (CodeMirror panel) / Find next (large text)
records.required: Shared action result contract; retain renderer-appropriate matching.
records.acceptance: Next highlights/moves to correct match; wrap and no-match state announced; read failure visible.

records.label: Find previous (menu / Shift+F3) / Previous (Markdown search) / previous (CodeMirror panel)
records.required: One previous-match action presented only when supported.
records.acceptance: Moves to previous match, preserves query and selection; disabled/no-match states correct.

records.label: Close search (Markdown/Mermaid buttons) / close (CodeMirror search panel) / close_search internal command
records.required: Consistent close/Back behavior returning to document selection.
records.acceptance: Close hides query UI, restores expected focus and leaves document unchanged.

records.label: Go to line (menu / Ctrl+G)
records.required: Contextual line navigation using appropriate editor or large-text input.
records.acceptance: Valid line focuses target; invalid input receives useful feedback; no false success.

records.label: Undo (menu / Ctrl+Z)
records.required: Shared enabled state reflects undo stack; contextual editor action.
records.acceptance: Undo reverses latest eligible edit and dirty state; disabled when history empty.

records.label: Redo (menu / Ctrl+Shift+Z)
records.required: Shared enabled state reflects redo stack.
records.acceptance: Redo restores intended edit; new edit invalidates redo correctly.

records.label: Indent (menu / Tab)
records.required: Keep in editor tools/keyboard; omit from viewer chrome.
records.acceptance: Indents selected lines by configured tab width; read-only text cannot change.

records.label: Outdent (menu / Shift+Tab)
records.required: Keep beside Indent in contextual editor tools.
records.acceptance: Outdents selected lines safely; keyboard focus can still leave editor.

records.label: Toggle wrap
records.required: Explicit Wrap lines state in editor tools, with defined local-versus-default scope.
records.acceptance: Current state visible; toggling preserves caret/selection and document bytes.

records.label: Zoom out (menu / Ctrl+-) / − (image toolbar) / − (diagram toolbar)
records.required: All entry points invoke renderer-neutral zoom action; compact control shown contextually.
records.acceptance: Every exposed path changes same viewport; unavailable image disables action.

records.label: Zoom in (menu / Ctrl++) / + (image toolbar) / + (diagram toolbar)
records.required: Shared zoom action and truthful state feedback.
records.acceptance: Every entry point yields same zoom result; bounds and focus retained.

records.label: Edit source / View source (mode toggle) / Preview
records.required: Use Read / Edit modes with renderer support and source authority reflected; provide Edit a copy for read-only input.
records.acceptance: Toggle preserves source selection, edits and preview identity; read-only remains read-only.

records.label: Save (menu / Ctrl+S) / Save (unsaved-changes dialog)
records.required: Use verified save receipts. Reuse Android Save As/create-document mechanics; add in-place save only when authority, conflict and outcome handling are supported.
records.acceptance: Write changed bytes, verify receipt, reopen; failure/cancellation never discards draft.

records.label: File information (menu) / File information (image tools)
records.required: Common document-info action in overflow/tools.
records.acceptance: Reachable on phone in success/error states; displays active document's facts.

records.label: Outline (menu)
records.required: Contextual outline sheet/list with selection and dismissal.
records.acceptance: Correct headings shown; selecting entry scrolls to it and returns useful focus.

records.label: Print (menu / Ctrl+P)
records.required: Offer only when host can complete print; keep in secondary actions.
records.acceptance: Opens usable print flow or is absent with clear capability scope; source unaffected.

records.label: Edit a copy
records.required: Create an editable draft copy, label its unsaved status and route persistence through Save copy/create-document.
records.acceptance: Original bytes remain intact; edits save to a chosen destination and reopen exactly; cancel preserves the draft.

records.label: Previous page (PageUp)
records.required: Keep capability conditional; do not expose as dead control.
records.acceptance: Action absent until renderer supplies valid navigation result.

records.label: Next page (PageDown)
records.required: Keep capability conditional; no placeholder page controls.
records.acceptance: Action absent until renderer supplies valid navigation result.

records.label: Text editing/selection surface
records.required: Retain editor engine inside adaptive shell with proper IME/inset ownership.
records.acceptance: Typing, selection, paste, multiline editing and keyboard dismissal preserve caret and content.

records.label: Document details disclosure
records.required: Move technical detail into document information or compact disclosure.
records.acceptance: Disclosure keyboard/touch accessible; opening never consumes required editor controls.

records.label: Language mode selector
records.required: Labelled selector in editor/document tools; retain automatic detection and explicit override.
records.acceptance: All 11 options selectable; override changes highlighting only; stored scope clear.

records.label: Find text field (CodeMirror)
records.required: Responsive labelled Find field, current query and match state.
records.acceptance: IME remains usable; field and adjacent actions fit phone width; search updates matches.

records.label: all (select all matches)
records.required: Expose Select all matches in advanced find actions when editable/meaningful.
records.acceptance: Selects all matches without unintended text changes; count announced.

records.label: match case checkbox
records.required: Accessible Match case toggle in find options.
records.acceptance: Changes matching semantics; checked state visible and announced.

records.label: regexp checkbox
records.required: Label Regular expression, with useful invalid-pattern feedback.
records.acceptance: Invalid expression does not hang or silently fail; option state clear.

records.label: by word checkbox
records.required: Label Whole word in find options.
records.acceptance: Whole-word matching works with current query; selection does not change text.

records.label: Replace text field
records.required: Separate labelled replacement field under Find; collapse when read-only.
records.acceptance: Editable state exposes field; read-only hides replacement controls; IME usable.

records.label: replace (next match)
records.required: Replace next action with undo support.
records.acceptance: Replaces intended match once; dirty state and undo update correctly.

records.label: replace all
records.required: Clearly scoped Replace all with result count and undo.
records.acceptance: Replaces intended matches only; large input remains responsive; result can be undone.

records.label: Go to line input
records.required: Labelled numeric-friendly line field in compact dialog.
records.acceptance: Valid/invalid line values handled; keyboard does not cover submit/close.

records.label: go (submit line)
records.required: Go action plus Back/Escape dismissal.
records.acceptance: Moves caret to requested line and closes dialog; cancellation preserves selection.

records.label: Find rendered text field
records.required: Compact find tool using common search presentation.
records.acceptance: Queries match visible content; current match scrolls into view; all controls reachable with IME.

records.label: Outline heading entries
records.required: Heading list/sheet with hierarchy and current target.
records.acceptance: Every heading entry reaches correct content; long labels wrap without clipping.

records.label: External document link / Email link
records.required: Preserve destination disclosure using accessible link semantics and native external launch.
records.acceptance: Correct URL/mail target shown; blocked schemes remain inactive; cancellation safe.

records.label: Internal fragment link / Footnote reference / Footnote return link
records.required: Consistent link behavior with destination focus and readable offsets.
records.acceptance: Each anchor reaches correct target below chrome; keyboard and touch equivalent.

records.label: Local document link
records.required: Expose only authorized resolvable local destinations with clear unavailable state.
records.acceptance: Opens intended local file without losing current draft; missing permission offers recovery.

records.label: Open destination (external-link dialog)
records.required: Retain explicit destination plus visible Opening/failed state in common dialog.
records.acceptance: One launch per activation; failure stays recoverable; focus returns on cancel/finish.

records.label: Cancel (external-link dialog)
records.required: Common dialog cancellation with Android Back.
records.acceptance: Cancel/Back launches nothing and restores originating link focus.

records.label: Retry preview (contained error / paused-preview banner)
records.required: Content-area Retry only for recoverable conditions; preserve source fallback.
records.acceptance: Injected preview failure leaves shell usable; retry restores preview without losing edits.

records.label: View source (Markdown failure) / View source (Mermaid failure) / View source (embedded Mermaid caption)
records.required: Consistent source fallback with context-specific selection.
records.acceptance: Markdown failure opens source; Mermaid fallback opens diagram source; embedded action selects correct fence.

records.label: Find diagram text field
records.required: Clear diagram search with meaningful match highlighting/navigation if offered.
records.acceptance: Matching content is identifiable; query count is accurate; Back returns to diagram.

records.label: Fit (standalone / embedded diagram)
records.required: Contextual Fit action and gesture alternative; reuse common action model.
records.acceptance: Fits correct diagram without changing source; nested diagram controls target their own viewport.

records.label: Actual size (standalone / embedded diagram)
records.required: Secondary view option in tool sheet.
records.acceptance: Sets defined 100% view; preserves accessible route when gesture unavailable.

records.label: Pan left
records.required: Secondary accessible pan control; primary touch drag.
records.acceptance: Moves viewport left within bounds; label meaningful to assistive tech.

records.label: Pan right
records.required: Secondary accessible pan control; primary touch drag.
records.acceptance: Moves viewport right within bounds; no document page scroll collision.

records.label: Pan up
records.required: Secondary accessible pan control; primary touch drag.
records.acceptance: Moves viewport up within bounds; keyboard equivalent available.

records.label: Pan down
records.required: Secondary accessible pan control; primary touch drag.
records.acceptance: Moves viewport down within bounds; visible content remains recoverable with Fit.

records.label: Diagram canvas drag / keyboard navigation
records.required: Preserve gesture surface with documented alternatives and controlled event ownership.
records.acceptance: Drag affects intended diagram; keyboard focus can leave; embedded diagrams do not trap page scroll.

records.label: Fit
records.required: Primary contextual fit/reset option; no horizontal control scrolling.
records.acceptance: Fits loaded image; disabled without usable preview; reachable at compact widths.

records.label: Actual size
records.required: Secondary 100% view action in image tools.
records.acceptance: Displays defined actual-size viewport; text scaling does not hide control.

records.label: Reset view
records.required: Clarify reset scope; separate background preference if reset should only reset position/zoom.
records.acceptance: Reset outcome matches label; no unrelated state changes.

records.label: Background selector (Checkerboard / Light / Dark)
records.required: Labelled background choice within image tools.
records.acceptance: All three options preview immediately; value persists at intended scope and is accessible.

records.label: Image viewport pinch / drag / keyboard navigation
records.required: Retain direct manipulation with accessible buttons; avoid competing page gestures.
records.acceptance: Pinch, drag, orientation and keyboard operate within bounds; Fit recovers content.

records.label: Play / Pause
records.required: Small contextual playback control with clear state and reduced-motion explanation.
records.acceptance: Play/pause work; backgrounding stops playback; reduced-motion policy visible and consistent.

records.label: Previous frame
records.required: Frame navigation in focused animation controls.
records.acceptance: Steps exactly one frame, pauses playback, respects first-frame boundary.

records.label: Next frame
records.required: Frame navigation in focused animation controls.
records.acceptance: Steps exactly one frame, pauses playback, respects last-frame boundary.

records.label: Animation frame number input
records.required: Labelled current-frame selector with total and clear validation.
records.acceptance: Valid frame selects correct image; invalid/empty/out-of-range values handled without silent reset.

records.label: Icon entry selector
records.required: Readable entry list showing essential size/format; technical detail secondary.
records.acceptance: Select every entry on phone; failures labelled; long details do not force horizontal scrolling.

records.label: Export selected entry as PNG
records.required: Secondary export action with destination picker and receipt feedback.
records.acceptance: Saved PNG matches selected entry; cancel/failure explicit; original unchanged.

records.label: Retry preview
records.required: Retry transient failures; explain unsupported SVG features with useful alternative actions.
records.acceptance: Repeated retry not offered as solution to deterministic refusal; transient retry succeeds without duplicate work.

records.label: Previous window
records.required: Readable Previous section action in large-file tools.
records.acceptance: Loads prior chunk without lost position; disabled at start; errors visible.

records.label: Next window
records.required: Readable Next section action with position context.
records.acceptance: Loads next chunk without skipping bytes; disabled at end; cancellation safe.

records.label: Find text field
records.required: Common find presentation with bounded-search progress.
records.acceptance: Search responds on large files; cancel/error/no-match distinguishable.

records.label: Line number field
records.required: Validated positive line input with clear constraints.
records.acceptance: Rejects empty/NaN/negative/out-of-range entries; IME does not obscure Go.

records.label: Go to line (large-file action)
records.required: Explicit loading/error outcome and cancellation.
records.acceptance: Reaches requested line or reports not found/read failure; no unhandled rejection.

records.label: Copy window
records.required: Copy visible section with exact scope label and clipboard receipt.
records.acceptance: Clipboard contains displayed section; unsupported/denied write produces visible error.

records.label: Close file information
records.required: Compact sheet Close/Back; expanded inspector may remain nonmodal.
records.acceptance: Dismisses once, restores correct opener and cancels active checksum work.

records.label: Copy available information
records.required: Retain scoped bulk copy and privacy exclusions.
records.acceptance: Copied facts match visible allowed data; status is visible and announced.

records.label: Expand information / Collapse information
records.required: Use accessible sheet expansion or explicit full-screen details view.
records.acceptance: Expansion state labelled; drag/Back/Close behavior consistent; controls remain reachable.

records.label: Calculate SHA-256
records.required: Secondary technical action with progress and result copy.
records.acceptance: One computation per request; closing cancels; errors and checksum availability clear.

records.label: Embedded metadata observation disclosures
records.required: Readable advanced observation disclosure; retain provenance below primary facts.
records.acceptance: Each disclosure toggles by keyboard/touch; long values wrap; no hidden expansion state.

records.label: Copy individual fact
records.required: Compact labelled copy icon/button beside value.
records.acceptance: Copies exact chosen fact and reports completion/failure; 48dp target without bloating rows.

records.label: Disclose to copy
records.required: Clearly explain exact value/scope before copy; preserve existing disclosure rule.
records.acceptance: No copy before explicit action; confirmation associated with correct fact.

records.label: Cancel sensitive fact copy
records.required: Small Cancel action within same confirmation.
records.acceptance: Cancels without clipboard change and returns focus to originating disclosure.

records.label: Close preferences
records.required: Common sheet/page Close/Back behavior.
records.acceptance: Returns to prior document and focus; preference changes persist as defined.

records.label: Theme selector (System / Light / Dark)
records.required: Labelled three-choice selector in preferences.
records.acceptance: All choices apply to app, tools and renderer; System follows OS; contrast retained.

records.label: Editor font family field
records.required: Validated font choice with preview and explicit custom-value fallback.
records.acceptance: Unavailable font gets explained fallback; arbitrary input cannot break layout.

records.label: Editor font size field (8–72)
records.required: Validated stepper/field with live readable preview.
records.acceptance: Empty/invalid values handled; 200% text scaling keeps actions usable.

records.label: Tab width field (1–16)
records.required: Validated editor setting with clear units.
records.acceptance: Only supported widths persist; indentation matches displayed value.

records.label: Wrap long lines checkbox
records.required: Clear switch for default wrapping; distinguish current-document override.
records.acceptance: Toggle updates expected editors without changing file bytes; state persists.

records.label: Markdown default (Rendered / Source)
records.required: Label as Default Markdown view with explanatory scope.
records.acceptance: Newly opened Markdown follows selection; current unsaved editor is not silently replaced.

records.label: Reset preferences
records.required: Clearly scoped Reset settings with confirmation or reversible feedback as appropriate.
records.acceptance: Defaults restored, files untouched, success/failure visible; cancel preserves settings.

records.label: Save As (unsaved-changes dialog; required regular action)
records.required: Use Android create-document mechanics: source-bound Save As for existing sources, a separate draft-create/save contract for new documents.
records.acceptance: Choose name/destination, write, receive receipt and reopen; cancel/failure preserves draft.

records.label: Discard (unsaved changes)
records.required: Explicit discard scope and safe handling of in-flight writes.
records.acceptance: Cannot race pending write into unintended data loss; chosen draft only discarded.

records.label: Cancel (unsaved changes)
records.required: Common cancel/Back path with clear return to editing.
records.acceptance: No close or data loss; focus returns and pending operation state is coherent.

records.label: Recover
records.required: Retain recovery with document identity and clear next Save step.
records.acceptance: Recovered text matches record; original not overwritten without explicit save.

records.label: Decline recovery
records.required: Clearly describe effect on recovery record; distinct from decide-later.
records.acceptance: Only selected record declined; no ambiguity with cancel; failure visible.

records.label: Not now
records.required: Retain defer action and Android Back equivalence.
records.acceptance: Record remains available for later recovery; current document state unchanged.

records.label: Close diagnostics
records.required: Common close icon/Back in diagnostic sheet/page.
records.acceptance: Always reachable while JSON scrolls; returns to document and restores opener.

records.label: Export previewed bundle
records.required: Native save/share of exactly previewed redacted JSON, with exporting/cancelled/saved/failed receipt.
records.acceptance: Export creates readable bundle on Android; chosen destination receives exact bytes; failed export visible.

records.label: Clear diagnostics
records.required: Clearly scoped clear action with result feedback; avoid erasing evidence accidentally.
records.acceptance: Only diagnostic events cleared; failure retains preview; files/preferences untouched.

records.label: Share diagnostic bundle
records.required: Invoke Android Sharesheet with the frozen redacted JSON, correct MIME and temporary readable URI grants.
records.acceptance: Receiving app can read the payload; cancellation is neutral; handoff is never described as confirmed delivery.

records.label: CommandBar generated command buttons
records.required: Remove dead presentation or deliberately reuse the same action model; do not count as active UI.
records.acceptance: Build/reference audit confirms one intended command presentation per layout.

records.label: Rendered task checkbox (Completed task / Incomplete task)
records.required: Preserve read-only task state in viewer; editing belongs in source unless task editing is explicitly added.
records.acceptance: State is announced accurately; tapping does not falsely appear to save a change.
